Professional FortiGate security configuration generator based on CIS Benchmark standards for enterprise firewall hardening.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the FortiGate Security Hardening Tool.
- Provides API endpoints to generate FortiGate firewall configurations based on CIS Benchmark standards.
- Allows users to customize security hardening profiles with flexible options for firewall, SSL/TLS, admin access, logging, and authentication.
- Includes endpoints to view available configuration options and perform health checks.
- Supports multiple pricing plans with tiered API usage limits.
